summary: BEARFRAME: GHOST SIGNAL frontend regression + new-features test for Mission 02, case file, stealth, hiding, hazards, and touch. All 13 review-request feature flows pass end-to-end. No blocking defects; a couple of minor cosmetic observations noted.

issues: Dialog panel overlaps the left edge of the on-screen D-pad visually, but the pad itself still works and the dialog/choice buttons remain fully tappable. Could be tightened by reducing dialog width or raising it slightly above the controls.

Touch controls (D-pad + SCAN/LIGHT/USE) are displayed on desktop whenever the user turned the TOUCH setting ON. This matches the implementation (settings.touch === 'on' forces touch UI), but on a large screen the D-pad visually clips with the dialog box. In AUTO mode this never happens; only an issue if a desktop user manually turned touch on.

critical_code_review_comments: game.js is 423 lines (up from 282). Still readable but close to the 700-line threshold; render() alone is ~75 lines of canvas ops and could be split.
mission2.js wrong-sensor penalty teleports player to (28*T, 22*T+22). That is exactly the gallery entrance per the spec. Verified via m.update() direct call.

doScan() iterates ents and sets e.offT on lenses; no issue found, but initialising lens.offT=0 in entities() would avoid the 'undefined vs number' comparison in render() (currently works because of `e.offT > this.time` short-circuits with undefined).
ui.caseTab auto-opens the LAST item (i===items.length-1 → open()). A nice detail, but combined with empty-list placeholder text it is correct in both branches — verified.
ui.pick is called from pointerdown AND Digit1/2 keyboard path; both exercised, no duplicate-pick guard needed because choiceCb is cleared immediately.

lens entity is drawn only when `e.ang !== undefined` is set — it is set lazily inside updateWorld. First frame before any update sets it, the sweep wedge is not drawn. Minor cosmetic only; verified not to produce errors.
game.restore() clamps restored energy to min 50 inside applySnap(s, 50). Still uses setTimeout(600ms); mode is 'restoring' during that window so input is correctly ignored.
mission2 drones share the same zone [13,12,31,19]; BFS target clamping to zone is correct and prevents them from leaving the spine.
seed_data_creation: none — all state driven through window.__gs debug hook and localStorage reset between flows
context_for_next_testing_agent: Game is a static site served at http://localhost:3000. Debug hook: window.__gs (Game). mode in ['title','play','dialog','choice','terminal','case','pause','ending','restoring']. Key testids used: title-screen, continue-button, new-game-button, mission2-button, case-file, case-button, case-close, case-tab-evidence, case-tab-logs, case-item-<id>, case-list, case-detail, pause-menu, pause-case-button, resume-button, hud-stealth, choice-1, choice-2, touch-controls, touch-interact, touch-scan, touch-light, touch-dpad, next-mission-button, ending-title-button. LocalStorage keys: bearframe_ghost_signal_save_v1, _progress_v1, _settings_v1. To jump straight to M2: set progress unlocked.m2=true. Advance dialogs by pressing KeyE; avoid f-strings containing escaped quotes in python playwright scripts (syntax error). When testing drone 'hide refused while chasing': place drone 1 tile from player, set d.state='chase'; d.vis=true; d.blind=0; d.last={x:p.x,y:p.y}; then press E immediately — don't wait long, or sees() will recompute vis=false. Direct game.doScan() avoids keyboard-timing races. Fast-forwarding an echo: for(let i=0;i<400;i++) g.updateWorld(0.1) completes any projector path within one JS call.
